snippet.title: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up | Official Trailer | Steam, Nov 12
snippet.description:
3,816 board game boxes. One messy shop. All the time in the world to put things right.

Arthur ran this little board game shop for thirty years. Now it's yours, and last night his grandson Theo played with every single game. Gather stacks of copies, shelve each game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5404460/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

✦ 318 board games, 12 copies each, all with their own parody covers
✦ 15 categories on two floors: a sunny greenhouse, a candle-lit horror room, a detective's office and a reading loft
✦ Carry whole stacks, toss boxes, unlock 7 skills
✦ No timers, no pressure: tidy at your own pace
✦ Fully localized in 12 languages
✦ Windows & macOS, out November 12, 2026

🎥 Streamers & creators: streaming and monetization are welcome, no permission needed. Press kit and key requests: https://www.boomgames.co/press/cozy-board-game-shop/

Follow the shop:
Instagram & TikTok: @cozyboardgameshop
X: @cozyboardshop

Made by Boom Games, an independent studio in Istanbul.
